record.title: Partial unavailability of the Cloud Backup service

updates.body:
From 10:00 to 13:00 Moscow time, the service will be operated by the backup provider.
At this point, it can be observed:
– Unavailability of operations for connecting virtual machines to the service, management of backup and backup policies through the user interface, CLI and API for up to 60 minutes;
– There may be problems in starting and executing backup tasks, as well as a drop in the speed of creating and restoring backups.
The provider's work has been completed, and the service is operating normally.
